idni-80-update.label: Follow-up comment on IDNI/tau-testnet #80 (validator request)
idni-80-update.text: Quick update from our side. The node behind this request has been running since Oct 27 at node.tauhud.com and is fully synced to the tip (status: https://tauhud.com/status/). The key stays idle until it appears in the active set; the node will not propose before that (validator-gate patch, infra/node/patches in jimb000o/tau-command-hud). Pubkey again for convenience: 80ad4a20099a0d9002c67ffd0094587c2238fbe84d24d41861481936bce25779a64f4ba12ef7825051a9507f11d536b8. Happy to adjust anything on our end, or to test a second validator on a staging genesis first if that is easier for you. Thanks!

launch-tg-tau.label: Tau community on Telegram: introduce Tau HUD
launch-tg-tau.text:
hey everyone :) i built a little live dashboard for the testnet: https://tauhud.com
blocks, proposals and votes as they happen, plus a guide to vote yourself. unofficial, just a fan project. feedback very welcome!
